# Test fixtures

`pyxlsb-test1-v2.2.3.b64` is the small, generic `test1.xlsb` workbook fixture
from [pandas v2.2.3](https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/v2.2.3/pandas/tests/io/data/excel/test1.xlsb).
The pandas project uses the BSD 3-Clause License. The fixture is stored as
Base64 text so the repository's portable-content check can continue rejecting
tracked operational spreadsheet files. Decoded SHA-256:
`ab0c0a28a93a9174a4052446f61c21a626f7411f269e72af1d258569f8b533c2`.

The complete upstream terms are retained in [LICENSE.pandas](LICENSE.pandas).
